visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a white Nike sweatshirt and gold watch, sits in a living room holding a red-labeled plastic jar of pork jerky. A framed landscape painting hangs on the wall behind him. (2) The man points directly at the jar's label while speaking enthusiastically, his facial expressions are animated and focused on the product. (3) He opens the jar's lid and extracts a thin, dried strip of meat, demonstrating its texture to the camera in a medium close-up shot. (4) The camera cuts to a close-up of his face as he places the jerky in his mouth, chewing vigorously with a satisfied expression. (5) Another hand enters the frame from the right, reaching into the jar to take some jerky, while the man continues talking and holding the jar open. (6) A macro shot shows a single piece of the brown, fibrous jerky held between fingers against a blurred background of the man's hand. (7) The man looks directly into the lens, holding the jar up and gesturing with his index finger to emphasize his recommendation. (8) The video concludes with a close-up shot looking down into the jar, showing the thin, dried pork strips and text overlay regarding the purchase link.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins with a fast speech rate and high pitch variability over a bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong 4/4 beat. (2) A distinct mechanical clicking sound is heard as the man opens the jar, followed by a series of crisp crunching sounds as he chews the jerky, with the BGM remaining constant in the background. (3) The primary male voice maintains an enthusiastic, high-arousal tone while describing the product's origin and taste. (4) A brief female voice is heard laughing and expressing enjoyment ("好好吃喔") with a bright, positive valence as the man continues his sales pitch. (5) The audio concludes with a final swell of the BGM as the male voice provides a firm, authoritative call to action regarding the purchase price and link.
